constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the EffectParameterBlock class.

parameters.parameter: The Effect used to generate the EffectParameterBlock .

method.name: Apply
method.summary: Applies the parameter changes in the EffectParameterBlock to the current effect state.

overload.summary: Applies the parameter changes in the EffectParameterBlock to the current effect state.

method.name: Begin
method.summary: Begins capturing parameter state changes from the parent Effect.

overload.summary: Begins capturing parameter state changes from the parent Effect.

exceptions.exception: Begin has been called before calling End after the last call to Begin. Begin cannot be called again until End has been successfully called.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Immediately releases the unmanaged resources used by this object.

overload.summary: Immediately releases the unmanaged resources used by this object.
Releases the unmanaged resources used by the EffectParameterBlock and optionally releases the managed resources.
overload.remarks: This method is called by the public Dispose method and the Finalize method. Dispose invokes the protected Dispose(Boolean) method with the disposing parameter set to true . Finalize invokes Dispose(Boolean) with disposing set to false . When the disposing parameter is true , this method releases all resources held by any managed objects that this EffectParameterBlock references. This method invokes the Dispose method of each referenced object. Note Notes to Inheritors Dispose can be called multiple times by other objects. When overriding Dispose(Boolean) , be careful not to reference objects disposed of in an earlier call to Dispose .

method.name: End
method.summary: Stops capturing state changes from the parent Effect.

overload.summary: Stops capturing state changes from the parent Effect.

exceptions.exception: End was called, but Begin has not yet been called. Begin must be called successfully before End can be called.

method.name: Finalize
method.summary: Allows this object to attempt to free resources and perform other cleanup operations before garbage collection reclaims the object.

overload.summary: Allows this object to attempt to free resources and perform other cleanup operations before garbage collection reclaims the object.
